name: Nestle Crunch Trend: Star in the 1980s Crunch Commercial
blurb: The Nestle Crunch trend is a UK TikTok wave from October 2026: a Nestle Crunch AI filter puts your face into the 1980s Nestle Crunch commercial, where you grin at the camera, bite the chocolate bar and pull cheeky faces.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Create a photorealistic vertical video of the person in [Image 1] as the star of a classic 1980s TV commercial for a crispy milk chocolate bar. Never write the words of this prompt, photo labels or file names as text anywhere in the video.

The star is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face and hair from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. The same face and the same age as in [Image 1] from the first frame to the last: never younger, never morphing. They wear the clothes from [Image 1].

THE SET: a bright TV studio set made to look like a sunny suburban backyard: a painted backdrop of leafy green trees and a pale yellow wooden house with white siding and a window, soft even light from the front, warm sunny colors.

THE BAR: one classic full-size milk chocolate bar with crisped rice inside, half unwrapped: a white paper wrapper with a deep blue band at each end and a thin red stripe, NO letters, NO logo, NO words on it; the chocolate end shows the bumpy crisped-rice texture and one corner is already bitten off.

THE LOOK: a classic 1980s TV commercial played from an old, worn VHS tape: soft focus, warm faded colors, a slight color bleed at the edges, light tape noise, faint scan lines and a gentle tracking wobble now and then. Vertical 9:16, full frame.

ONE CONTINUOUS CLOSE-UP, NO CUTS: from the chest up, the face large, sharp and centered, looking straight into the lens; the camera almost still, with a tiny slow push-in.

0-1.5 s: the person holds the bar up beside the cheek, the wrapper toward the camera, and beams into the lens with a huge, open, cheeky grin.

1.5-4 s: big, over-the-top TV-ad faces into the camera to the beat of the jingle: eyes wide, eyebrows up, an excited "ooh" mouth, a little head bob from side to side, a quick wink.

4-5.5 s: they bring the bar to the mouth and take one big bite, eyes closed: a loud, crispy crunch.

5.5-7.5 s: they chew happily and tilt the head back and to the side with a dreamy, blissful face, lips pressed together.

7.5-10 s: they snap back to the camera with wide eyes and puffed cheeks, then give a cheeky raised-eyebrow grin, the bar held up next to the face until the end.

Audio: a bright, bouncy 1980s TV commercial jingle on synth, drum machine and handclaps, an original tune, purely instrumental: NO singing, NO lyrics, NO voice-over, no brand name spoken. On the bite, a loud, crispy crunch; then one happy "Mmm!" from the person. No other words.

Exactly one person in the frame. Five fingers on each hand. One single chocolate bar. NO text anywhere: no letters or logo on the wrapper, no slogan, no title, no captions, no subtitles, no on-screen date, no REC mark, no channel logo, no watermark. NO cuts, NO morphing.

The pet is the one in [Image 1], in every frame: the same species and breed, face, eyes, ears, muzzle, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner recognizes it at once. A real animal with its own legs and paws: never a human body, never human hands, no clothes.

THE SET: a bright TV studio set made to look like a sunny suburban backyard: a painted backdrop of leafy green trees and a pale yellow wooden house with white siding and a window, soft even light from the front, warm sunny colors.

THE BAR: one classic full-size milk chocolate bar with crisped rice inside, half unwrapped: a white paper wrapper with a deep blue band at each end and a thin red stripe, NO letters, NO logo, NO words on it; the chocolate end shows the bumpy crisped-rice texture and one corner is already bitten off.

THE LOOK: a classic 1980s TV commercial played from an old, worn VHS tape: soft focus, warm faded colors, a slight color bleed at the edges, light tape noise, faint scan lines and a gentle tracking wobble now and then. Vertical 9:16, full frame.

ONE CONTINUOUS CLOSE-UP, NO CUTS: the pet sits on a low wooden table in front of the backdrop, seen whole from the front, the face large and sharp, looking into the lens. A grown-up's hand comes in from the left edge and holds the bar up next to the pet: only the hand and the wrist show, never a face. The camera almost still.

0-2 s: the pet sits up and looks straight into the camera, ears up, bright-eyed, the bar held up beside it.

2-5 s: big, cheeky TV-ad faces: wide eyes, a head tilt to one side, then the other, a happy open mouth as if it laughs, a lick of the lips.

5-7.5 s: it leans toward the bar, sniffs the bitten corner, gives the wrapper one tiny lick and closes its eyes with a blissful face. It never bites or eats the chocolate.

7.5-10 s: it looks back into the camera with wide eyes and a cheeky, happy face, licking its lips, until the end.

Audio: a bright, bouncy 1980s TV commercial jingle on synth, drum machine and handclaps, an original tune, purely instrumental: NO singing, NO lyrics, NO voice-over, no brand name spoken. One small happy sound of the pet's own kind. No words.

Exactly one animal and no person, only the one hand that holds the bar. One single chocolate bar. NO text anywhere: no letters or logo on the wrapper, no slogan, no title, no captions, no subtitles, no on-screen date, no REC mark, no channel logo, no watermark. NO cuts, NO morphing.
